policy.quality: No convergence or 2/3/5 epoch loss measured. H64 may underfit or yield worse held-out loss; smaller architecture must be evaluated.

policy.timing_scope: Short real data throughput only; full epoch times extrapolated. Setup/evaluation/checkpoint/long thermal excluded.
